verdict.rationale: Direct probe evidence confirms LibreChat hosts a working llms.txt at https://www.librechat.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) explicitly described as a 'curated map of the LibreChat documentation for language models and coding agents,' plus a docs.md markdown-friendly docs page, both purpose-built for agent consumption. missing for 10: no independent/community confirmation that agents actually use these files successfully in practice.
